attributes.title: 2027 TPA Conference & Expo
attributes.venue: Marriott Dallas Allen Hotel & Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The Texas Pharmacy Association holds its 2027 Conference & Expo from July 23 to 25, 2027, at the Marriott Dallas Allen Hotel & Convention Center in Allen, north of Dallas. The weekend brings Texas pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and student pharmacists together for education, an expo hall and networking.

TPA advertises CE credit at its annual conference, but the 2027 CE hours, program and registration fees have not been published yet. We will update this page when TPA opens registration.
